purpose: Daily/weekly drift hash: 5-10 deterministic prompts run at temperature 0 against the same judge config. SHA256 of the JSON-serialised response is compared to baseline; any change signals a silent vendor model update (Sub-4 + Sub-5 sweeps).
scope_guard: Eval-time only on operator laptop. NEVER scheduled against the production droplet.

execution.frequency_recommendation: manual daily (v1); GitHub Actions cron later (v2)
execution.alert_on: any change to response_hash for any item compared to last successful baseline; alert payload includes (item_id, prev_hash, new_hash, gemini_model_version_seen)

items.user_prompt: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants and some other organisms use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to produce oxygen and energy in the form of sugar. The process occurs in chloroplasts, primarily in leaves. It is the foundation of nearly all life on Earth because it produces atmospheric oxygen and forms the base of most food chains.
